name: Itsukushima Shinto Shrine
description: On the island of Miyajima in Japan's Seto Inland Sea, this Shinto shrine is famous for its vermilion torii gate, which seems to float on the water at high tide. The present buildings, dating from the 12th century, stand linked by walkways between forested Mount Misen and the sea. The island has been regarded as sacred since ancient times, and a ferry from the mainland brings visitors.
